snippet.title: [Official Trailer] Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX - Racing Champions
snippet.description:
Official Trailer: Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions

Experience the very first video game adventure featuring the beloved Europa-Park mascots Ed & Edda! Ed & Edda: GRAND PRIX – Racing Champions is a family-friendly kart racing game developed by Tivola Games in close collaboration with MACK Magic and Europa-Park. Inspired by the animated film GRAND PRIX OF EUROPE, the game brings fast-paced, fun racing action straight to your living room.

Highlights:

🌆 Exciting races through London, Paris, and other iconic locations
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Local multiplayer for fun with family and friends
🚗 Power-ups, turbo boosts, and customizable driver profiles
🎨 Lovingly designed characters and detailed track environments

Play the free demo on Steam soon and get a first look at the game!
And don’t forget: Add the game to your Steam wishlist to stay up to date and help support the project’s visibility.
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/32...

Release: 24.07.2025
Coming to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam

Follow us for more content:
Gameplay, behind-the-scenes, character spotlights and more – on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Twitter. Find all links in our bio!
